capability: A checked rule can still be the wrong rule
title: Check the pin before the work.

hook.picture: Close: the line lands exactly on a pin and gets a tick. A pod downstream answers ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The checker said yes. The program still did the wrong thing.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: One pin, set once, just below where it should be. Three times, faster each time, runs land on it perfectly and pods answer ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The rule was written wrong, once.

stakes.body: A perfectly checked program can still do the wrong thing, and the green result makes everyone stop looking.

solution_hint: Test the rule, not only the work.

metaphor.body: The pin is the written rule. A gate compares the line with the pin, never with what you meant, so a second gate tests the pin against known answers.

steps.picture: A gate compares the line with the pin step by step, with a ring on each step.
A step that leaves the pin stops at the gate. The bar drops.
steps.words: A machine checks each step against the rule.

steps.picture: Push-in: a second gate with an example-card icon. Known right answers, as cards, are tested against the pin, and one doesn't fit.
steps.sound: Card taps, one of them sour

steps.picture: The pin flags itself in copper: the rule is wrong.
steps.words: The written rule is called the spec.

steps.picture: The whale moves the pin up to the ghost mark, and every example card fits.
The line follows the moved pin. Both gates glow.
steps.words: Check the spec against known answers too.

real_case.claim: Field results on Manu's FRONTIER topic page: Verus system proofs 81%, DafnyBench 92.7%, while Lean end-to-end is far lower (VERINA proof 4.9%). 'Verifier is an oracle for proofs, not specs.'

honest_limit.picture: A pin set wrong in a way no example card covers. The line follows it through both gates and the pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: No example covered this. It passed.

not_this.body: Checked against the rule. Not against your intent.

ending_pattern.body: An example card tests the bar-1 pin. It slides up to where the pod needed it, the line follows, and the pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing as bar 1: the pin that matched the line but missed the pod now meets both.

end_belief.body: Check your rules as hard as your work.
